# Sidebar

Vertical section nav with an active pill and grouped links; panel or flat placement.

Category: navigation · Behavior: none · Schema: 1.0.0 · Source: original

## Variants

| `data-uifa-variant` | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `panel` (default) | Owns a bordered surface for standalone placement. |
| `flat` | No surface of its own; embeds in existing chrome via `data-uifa-variant="flat"`. |

## Tokens

Reads: `--uifa-accent`, `--uifa-accent-soft`, `--uifa-border`, `--uifa-border-strong`, `--uifa-border-width`, `--uifa-duration`, `--uifa-ease`, `--uifa-faint`, `--uifa-font-body`, `--uifa-radius-control`, `--uifa-radius-surface`, `--uifa-space`, `--uifa-surface`, `--uifa-surface-2`, `--uifa-text`, `--uifa-text-base`, `--uifa-text-muted`. Every color comes from a semantic role; nothing is hard-coded.

## Markup

```html
<!-- Vertical section nav; mark the current page with aria-current="page". -->
<nav class="uifa-sidebar" data-uifa-variant="panel" aria-label="Sections">
  <a data-uifa-slot="link" href="#" aria-current="page">Overview</a>
  <a data-uifa-slot="link" href="#">Episodes</a>
  <div data-uifa-slot="group">
    <span data-uifa-slot="heading">Library</span>
    <a data-uifa-slot="link" href="#">Clips</a>
    <a data-uifa-slot="link" href="#">Assets</a>
  </div>
</nav>
```

## Usage

Vertical navigation: links are `data-uifa-slot="link"`; group them under `data-uifa-slot="group"` with a `data-uifa-slot="heading"` label. Mark the current section with `aria-current="page"` and give the nav an `aria-label`. Variant `panel` (default) draws its own bordered surface; `flat` drops it for embedding in app chrome.
